description:
**We are:**


NoGood is an award\-winning, tech\-enabled growth consultancy that has fueled the success of some of the most iconic brands.


We are a team of growth leads, creatives, engineers and data scientists who help unlock rapid measurable growth for some of the world’s category\-defining brands. We bring together the art and science of strategy, creative, content and growth expertise into a single cohesive team, powered by robust data analytics and proprietary AI tech.


Based in NYC, we support partners globally, with a client partner roster that includes VC\-backed startups, scale\-ups, and Fortune 500 companies such as Nike, Oura, Spring Health, TikTok, Intuit, P\&G, and more.


Since 2016, we’ve been delivering what others only promise. Why settle for good enough if you can be up to NoGood?

**We are looking for:**


A Growth Systems Engineer (AI \& Operations) — a hybrid AI engineer and technical operations builder responsible for designing, automating, and scaling the systems that power NoGood’s internal Growth OS. This role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, automation, data infrastructure, and workflow optimization. You will build AI agents, automate cross\-team processes, and support the technical foundation that helps our growth, creative, and analytics teams operate at peak efficiency.

**You have:**

* 3–5\+ years of experience in AI engineering, data engineering, systems engineering, automation, or technical operations.
* Strong proficiency in Python and building API\-driven integrations or automations.
* Experience working with cloud environments and modern data infrastructures.
* Familiarity with LLMs, AI/ML workflows, and deploying or integrating model\-driven systems.
* Strong ability to map internal processes and translate them into scalable, automated solutions.
* A systems mindset with attention to reliability, monitoring, and long\-term maintainability.
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with growth, creative, analytics, and operations teams.
* High ownership, bias for action, and comfort with ambiguous or evolving problems.
* Bonus: experience in growth marketing, analytics, or creative operations.

**You will do:**

* Build and maintain lightweight AI tools and agents to support internal teams and operational workflows.
* Automate recurring processes across teams to reduce manual work and increase efficiency.
* Develop internal scripts, services, and automations that unify workflows and data across the company.
* Improve system reliability through better monitoring, error handling, and documentation.
* Support internal data infrastructure by streamlining ingestion, transformation, and operational reporting workflows.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify bottlenecks and design scalable, technical solutions.
* Contribute to the ongoing development of NoGood’s AI\-native Growth OS, helping shape how work is done across teams.
* Evaluate new AI technologies and automation tools to enhance internal operations.
* Document systems and provide internal training where needed.
* Champion a mindset of technical excellence, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**EEO \& Compensation Transparency Statement:**


NoGood is committed to pay transparency and equity among all employees and provides employees an environment where pay transparency and dialogue on compensation are allowed. NoGood complies with federal, state, and local laws on compensation, pay transparency, and pay equity. We take factors including geographic location, education, training, skillset, market rates, certifications, and more into consideration when constructing pay ranges for new and existing roles within our organization.


At NoGood, we understand that diversity in the workplace is vital to a company’s success and growth. We strive to make sure that our team members are included and have a sense of belonging that makes us a great company to work with and a great company to work for. To that end, NoGood is committed to Equal Opportunity Employment and complies with all Equal Opportunity Employment laws. We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will work to make reasonable accommodations available in the job application and interview process, to perform essential duties of the job function, and to retrieve other benefits and privileges of employment with our organization.


BEWARE OF FRAUD! Please be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious activity by persons that are posing as NoGood team members, recruiters, and HR employees. Our team will contact you regarding job opportunities from email addresses ending in @nogood.io or @higoodie.com. Additionally, we do utilize our ATS\- Workable\- to help us schedule initial screening calls. Job seeking is hard\- we’re sorry that scammers have added this element to your search for something new. Stay vigilant out there!

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
We're hiring a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and ship ML and LLM\-powered products and the infrastructure behind them. You'll work across the full stack — from data pipelines and model fine\-tuning through backend services and MLOps — and play a lead role in shaping how AI systems are built and operated across the organization. This is a hands\-on senior role with technical ownership and direct influence on AI products reaching enterprise and government customers.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 Design and implement production\-grade ML and LLM applications: RAG pipelines, fine\-tuning workflows, evaluation frameworks, and inference services.
 



 Fine\-tune open\-source LLMs (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Qwen) using techniques such as LoRA/QLoRA, SFT, and DPO for domain\-specific use cases.
 



 Build and operate the backend services that power our AI products — APIs, orchestration layers, async job processing, and integrations.
 



 Own MLOps practices: CI/CD for models, experiment tracking, model registry, monitoring, drift detection, and cost/performance optimization.
 



 Design and maintain data engineering pipelines that ingest, clean, transform, and serve structured and unstructured data to AI systems (text, PDF, audio, video).
 



 Build evaluation and observability tooling for LLM outputs (offline benchmarks, online metrics, human\-in\-the\-loop feedback loops).
 



 Collaborate with product, data, and infrastructure teams to translate business problems into deployable AI solutions.
 



 Mentor junior engineers, set technical standards, review code and architecture, and contribute to hiring.
 



 Required Qualifications
 



  





 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience focused on AI/ML or LLM systems in production.
 



 Strong NLP and LLM fine\-tuning experience: hands\-on work with Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT/LoRA, dataset curation, evaluation, and deployment of fine\-tuned models.
 



 MLOps background: model versioning, experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights \& Biases, or similar), containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD for ML workloads.
 



 Full\-stack engineering with backend focus: strong Python (FastAPI, Django) and proficiency building scalable APIs, async workers, and event\-driven services.
 



 Data engineering fundamentals: SQL and NoSQL databases, vector databases (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate, or Milvus), ETL/ELT pipeline design, and stream/batch processing.
 



 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and on\-premises GPU environments.
 



 Excellent communication skills in English; ability to work directly with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 Nice to Have
 



  





 Experience building AI agents and multi\-agent systems.
 



 Voice AI experience: ASR (Whisper, conformer\-based models), TTS, voice agent pipelines.
 



 Computer vision experience: detection, OCR, document understanding, or multimodal models.
 



 Classical ML expertise: XGBoost, scikit\-learn, feature engineering, and tabular modeling.
 



 Deep learning frameworks: PyTorch (preferred), TensorFlow.
 



 Data versioning and pipeline tooling: DVC, LakeFS, Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or Kubeflow Pipelines.
 



 LLM observability and tracing tools (LangFuse, Langsmith, Arize, Helicone).
 



 Arabic NLP experience or familiarity with localization challenges in the region.
 



 Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects or relevant publications.

*Hinweis: Technische Störung bei E\- Mail\- Benachrichtigungen* 




  





*Aktuell kommt es leider zu technischen Problemen bei der Zustellung automatisierter E\-Mails aus unserem Bewerbermanagementsystem. Davon betroffen sind unter anderem Eingangsbestätigungen, Zwischenbescheide und andere Benachrichtigungen. Wir arbeiten bereits an einer Lösung. Falls du keine Nachricht von uns erhalten hast oder unsicher bist, wende dich bitte direkt an die in der Stellenanzeige genannte Ansprechperson. Vielen Dank für dein Verständnis!* 




  





**Das erwartet dich bei uns** 




  




* Analyse komplexer Datensätze sowie Entwicklung, Fine\- Tuning und Monitoring von ML\- und AI‑Modellen (inkl. Drift Detection, Log\- Analysen, Classifier)
* Durchführung statistischer Analysen und systematische Tests von ML\- und LLM‑Modellen
* Aufbau robuster Evaluationspipelines (Validierung, Metriken, Benchmarking, Qualitätsbewertung von NLP‑Modellen)
* Analyse von Schwachstellen und Qualitätsabweichungen sowie iterative Optimierung der Modellperformance
* Entwicklung von Test‑ und Monitoring‑Frameworks für Modelle, Pipelines und AI‑Systeme sowie Design agentenbasierter Komponenten
* Zusammenarbeit mit Business‑Expert\*innen beim Prompt Engineering
* Graph Design in Python (optional Koog) sowie Datenaufbereitung und Aufbau skalierbarer Data‑ und AI‑Pipelines
* Anwendung von Software‑Engineering‑Best‑Practices für wartbare, reproduzierbare ML‑Workflows
* Zusammenarbeit in cross\- funktionalen Teams zur Übersetzung von Business\- Anforderungen in ML\-/AI‑Lösungen und Software Engineering Teams zur Überführung von Prototypen und Evaluationen in produktive Lösungen
* Verständliche Kommunikation von Ergebnissen an technische und nicht‑technische Stakeholder
* Erstellung technischer Dokumentation



  





  





**Das bringst du mit** 




  




* Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Data Science, Machine Learning oder MLOps
* Erfahrung im Aufbau von Data\- und ML\- Pipelines
* Data Engineering Erfahrung ist ein Plus
* Fundierte Kenntnisse in Python, ML\- Frameworks sowie im modernen ML\-/LLM\- Ökosystem (z. B. PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace, LangChain, LangGraph)
* Idealerweise Kenntnisse in Java
* Sicherer Umgang mit Software\- Engineering\- Best\- Practices (Versionierung, Testing, CI/CD, Code\- Qualität)
* Erfahrung mit Cloud\- Umgebungen wie Azure, AWS oder GCP
* Analytisches Denkvermögen, kritisches Hinterfragen bestehender Lösungen und starke Lernbereitschaft für KI und neue Technologien
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse



  





**Das bieten wir dir** 




  




* **Mach das Richtige mit Sinn und Zukunft:** 
 Unsere Services sparen Co₂ und schonen die Umwelt – wir arbeiten für eine nachhaltige Welt von morgen
* **Genieße viele Vorteile:** 
 Freu dich auf eine attraktive Vergütung, 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr sowie flexibel gestaltbare Arbeitszeiten, inkl. der Möglichkeit bis zu 50 % in der Woche mobil zu arbeiten
* **Sichere dir gute Perspektiven:** 
 Wir sind ein international erfolgreiches Unternehmen mit agilen Arbeitsmethoden und einer offenen Unternehmenskultur. Unser Zukunftskurs bietet dir langfristige und hervorragende Karriereoptionen.
* **Bleib neugierig und entwickle dich weiter** 
 : Stillstand ist für uns keine Option, deshalb fördern wir dich in jeder Hinsicht bei deiner Entwicklung – eine Vielzahl an Lernchancen warten auf dich
* **Erlebe eine Arbeitswelt voller Vertrauen** 
 : Wir ziehen alle an einem Strang
* **Hab Spaß in einem motivierten Team** 
 : Ob Grillevent, internationaler Soccer Cup oder auch mal Eis für alle im Sommer – wir lassen uns immer etwas Neues einfallen, sei gespannt!



  





**Was machen wir bei ista?** 




  





 Wir bei ista unterstützen Eigentümer:innen und Verwalter:innen von Immobilien, ihre Gebäude zukunftssicher und klimaneutral zu gestalten. Dazu gehört, dass wir Energieverbräuche messen, abrechnen und transparent machen. So helfen wir dabei, Energie und CO2 zu sparen. Daran arbeiten wir mit über 6\.300 Mitarbeiter:innen in 20 Ländern. Wir bieten dir die Sicherheit eines erfolgreichen Unternehmens und die Flexibilität einer agilen Arbeitsweise. Gestalte auch du mit uns die Zukunft.
 



  





 Bei ista sind alle Menschen unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Religion und Behinderung willkommen. Wir sind stolz, Teil eines vielfältigen Teams zu sein. Wir pflegen ein kollegiales Umfeld und unterstützen uns gegenseitig. Besonders die Vereinbarkeit von Privatleben und Beruf hat bei uns einen hohen Stellenwert. Auch ist uns die Förderung unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sehr wichtig, weshalb wir allen die Möglichkeit bieten, sich weiterzubilden und weiterzuentwickeln.

title: Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
**Excited about AI?**
 At ZDF Sparks, we focus on making AI tangible, turning complex ideas into reliable, scalable tools for the media industry. We are looking for a
 **Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d)** 
 in Full\-time (40h) who is ready to lead, build, and inspire at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI and real\-world media consultancy.
   

  

 You will be part of a high\-impact team in
 **Berlin (hybrid setup)** 
 , shaping the technical direction of our AI Engineering practice. The position is initially limited to 2 years with the option of extension and starts at the earliest possible date.
   

  

**Your Role**
*As a Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d) at ZDF Sparks, you won't just be delivering solutions, you will be setting the standard:*
* Lead \& Grow: You lead AI idea generation, product design, and requirement definitions for complex media industry challenges and you actively grow the next generation of engineers, supporting career paths from junior to senior level while role modeling a positive, agency\-style engineering culture.
* Own it End\-to\-End: You design scientifically state\-of\-the\-art AI products with the ability to evaluate success, ROI, and risks before a project kicks off, architected with a strong understanding of varying levels of technical sovereignty, including diverse cloud environments.
* Build \& Modernize: You design, review, implement, and modernize data systems and algorithms from data analytics to advanced AI/ML solutions and customize and fine\-tune AI models (e.g., text and image generation) for diverse real\-world applications across text, image, audio, and video.
* Make AI Explainable: You open\-source algorithms and translate complex AI logic into something meaningful for larger audiences and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Stay Ahead: You have an inherent passion for following the latest developments in generative AI, computer vision, and recommender systems and you bring that curiosity to everything you do.
* Bridge Builder: You collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including non\-technical media experts, to integrate AI solutions into real business processes.
* Communicate with Impact: You break down complex technical solutions and make them accessible and actionable for non\-technical media professionals.


**Your Profile**
*We're looking for a Senior Engineer (m/f/d) with a builder mindset and a passion for people as much as for technology:*
* 5\+ years of experience in Python\-based software and ML engineering, including data processing, model development, and production\-grade application design.
* Deep expertise in modern ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, HuggingFace) and classical ML tooling (scikit\-learn), with a strong foundation in feature engineering, model evaluation, and performance optimization.
* Proven experience architecting and deploying LLM\-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and conversational AI systems using frameworks such as LangChain or comparable tooling.
* Solid cloud engineering skills (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure for scalable AI services.
* Track record of designing and delivering end\-to\-end AI solutions, from prototyping and API development through to production deployment and monitoring.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced consultancy setting, comfortable balancing client\-facing advisory work with hands\-on technical delivery in a rapidly evolving AI landscape, including the ability to identify opportunities, shape AI solution proposals, and contribute to business development efforts.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and growing engineers: you define technical direction, conduct code reviews, and foster a culture of excellence.
* Self\-directed and solutions\-oriented: you identify key challenges and independently explore paths forward without waiting for structured tasks.
* Excellent communication skills in English and German.


**Our Commitment To You**
**ZDF Sparks** 
 is a workplace for
 **curious, ambitious, and collaborative AI trendsetters** 
 who are excited about working on new and continuously changing customer challenges. We proudly embrace
 **diversity** 
 and enjoy working in
 **fast\-paced, cross\-functional, and multicultural teams.**
 Our
 **hybrid work model** 
 is designed to support
 **personal flexibility and creativity,** 
 enabling a
 **healthy work\-life balance** 
 . We offer
 **flexible working hours** 
 and a hybrid setup to accommodate any personal circumstances.
   

  

 In our
 **centrally located Berlin top\-floor office** 
 , we enjoy
 **modern spaces with ergonomic workstations** 
 grouped to facilitate personal exchange and knowledge sharing, as well as closed rooms for larger meetings and quiet work.
   

  

 We network with our
 **ZDF office partners and visitors over lunches, talks, and afterwork get\-together events** 
 and engage in
 **fun team activities** 
 during regular company events.
   

  

 To support your professional growth, we offer opportunities for
 **further education through (external) regular workshops, hackathons, and networking events.**
 Additionally, we provide a
 **professional development budget (per employee)** 
 for conferences, certifications, or external courses.
   

  

 You will have
 **30 days of vacation to recharge (plus off on Christmas Eve and New Years eve).** 
 We also fully cover the cost of the
 **Deutschland\-Jobticket** 
 to support your commute.
   

  

**Our Values**
*At ZDF Sparks, our values are the cornerstone of everything we do:*
* Transparent: We believe in clear, open communication both within our team and with our clients. Your insights and knowledge will be valued and shared to drive collective success.
* Fun: We believe that work should be enjoyable and fulfilling. At ZDF Sparks, we maintain a light\-hearted atmosphere with humor and a relaxed communication style among colleagues. This fosters a positive environment where everyone feels comfortable and motivated to contribute their best, ensuring our collaborative efforts are both productive and enjoyable.
* Diverse: Our strength lies in our diverse team. Different perspectives and backgrounds drive our creativity and innovation, ensuring that our AI solutions are comprehensive and inclusive. By integrating different points of view, our collaborative team develops AI that reflects various experiences and meets the diverse needs of our clients.
* Innovative: We live and breathe innovation, continuously learning and pushing boundaries to deliver cutting\-edge AI solutions.


**Any Questions?**
 Your contact person is:
 **Nilofer Qayumi (People Partner \& Senior Technical Recruiter)**
 For any questions about the job advertisement and the application process, please contact career@zdf\-sparks.com.
   

  

 We look forward to getting to know you!
   

  

* At ZDF Sparks, diversity drives our innovation and strengthens our team. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued and respected. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected status.


**About Us**
 ZDF Sparks was founded in 2024 \- our data experts are an agile team dedicated to the development of AI solutions and algorithms for the media industry. We are focused on consulting, design and implementation of AI services, especially in the areas of algorithms, machine learning and data platforms for planning, communication, distribution and personalization of data and audiovisual content.
   

  

 We are the perfect place for curious, ambitious and collaborative AI trendsetters who are excited about working on new and changing challenges. We enjoy working in our fast\-paced, cross\-functional and diverse team where everyone feels comfortable and can fulfill their full potential.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**About us** 




 At Ada, we envision a world where everyone gets the healthcare they need. Yet, millions remain undiagnosed and untreated due to the complexity of identifying rare and underrecognized conditions, even when effective treatments exist.
 



  





 We’re changing that. Powered by leading AI and built by a team of physicians and clinical scientists, Ada helps people get answers faster, identifying those at risk and guiding them to the right care. Every successful journey makes us smarter and able to help more people.
 



  





 If you’re passionate about transforming healthcare and ensuring no one goes undiagnosed, join us and be part of what’s next.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As our Senior AI Engineer, you will play a key role in advancing the development, validation, and supporting tooling of our patented hybrid AI architecture. Our core technology combines Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs) with Generative AI to deliver explainable, transparent, and clinically robust medical reasoning. In this role, you will help shape how these components evolve and scale, ensuring they meet high standards for performance, reliability, and regulatory readiness.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of AI, you will operate at the intersection of medical intelligence and software engineering—translating complex requirements into sophisticated technical solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with AI researchers, engineers, and medical experts, contributing to both the strategic direction of the platform and the hands\-on implementation of production\-grade systems.
 



  





 This is a remote role, open to candidates based in the UK or Germany.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 



* **System Evolution:** 
 Refine and scale our patented hybrid engine, focusing on the interface between LLM\-based reasoning and probabilistic logic.
* **Engineering Excellence:** 
 Write and deploy high\-availability production code in
 **Java and Python** 
 , ensuring adherence to security and scalability standards.
* **Evaluation \& Tooling:** 
 Maintain and extend our internal evaluation and validation frameworks, including synthetic data generation, automated metric tracking, and model explainability.
* **Clinical Collaboration:** 
 Work with Medical Experts and AI Engineers to translate complex medical requirements into technical specifications.
* **Documentation:** 
 Provide technical documentation of AI components for stakeholders and regulatory compliance (e.g. SaMD).



  





**What you’ll bring** 



* A
 
 Master’s degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar). A PhD is a plus but is not essential.
* 3\+ years of (industry) experience in AI/ML or algorithmic development.
* Proficiency in Python (mainly for AI/Logic) and Java (mainly for backend services).
* Practical experience with classic ML and algorithms, such as Probabilistic Graphical Models (PGMs).
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs
 
 (ideally including RAG and Agents). Bonus points for exposure to their validation in production.
* Solid grasp of modern DevOps (Containerization, CI/CD, Automated Testing) and AI\-assisted development (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code).
* A high degree of autonomy and a preference for collaborative peer reviews and documentation.
* Experience working in cross\-functional teams, with a strong foundation in mathematics, logic, or statistical modelling to support rigorous problem\-solving would be advantageous.
* Exposure to the healthcare sector or other regulated environments (e.g., ISO 13485, MDR, SaMD), along with familiarity in areas such as Kotlin, advanced data visualisation, or MLOps would be highly beneficial.



  





**What’s awaiting you at Ada** 



* Flexible working hours to maintain a healthy work/life balance
* 28 days holiday, plus bank holidays to unplug, rest and recharge for our UK employees (30 days plus public holidays in Germany).
* Corporate health insurance and pension scheme (UK).
* Support to set up your home office space, with the option for a co\-working space subscription for our remote employees.
* Parental benefits (Plus Nursery Benefits for the UK).
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you look after your emotional wellbeing and deal with life’s challenges.
* Stay active and healthy with a discounted ClassPass membership (or Urban Sports Club membership for our employees in Germany).
* Bike Leasing Scheme (Germany).
* Online Academy for learning and development opportunities.



  





 At Ada, inclusivity isn't just a goal – it's our foundation.
 



  





 As a proud equal opportunity employer, we embrace diversity in all its forms. We encourage applications from every corner of society, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, national origin, age, physical and mental abilities, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by law.
 



  





 Join us in shaping a more inclusive tomorrow.
 



  





 Please note that we do
 **not** 
 accept applications sent via email. All applications need to be completed using the online form.
 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to GDPR guidelines.
 



 \*Any commercial activities concerning this advertisement will not be appreciated.

* Apply enterprise security controls, identity and access management, and secure API integration.

* Proven experience delivering AI/ML applications in production environments.

Yttrium is a growth equity firm specialized in B2B technology. We partner with management teams of high\-growth businesses and help them scale into global digital leaders. We currently manage over EUR 750m across more than 20 portfolio companies, supported by a team of 20\+ investment professionals and Advisory Partners based in Frankfurt, Munich and London.



Data and AI are central to how we source, diligence and monitor investments. Over the past two years we have built “Scale”, our in\-house data and AI platform: a data warehouse with ingestion pipelines, a suite of agentic workflows and MCP servers, and two full\-stack applications used day\-to\-day by the investment team. The foundation is live and in production; the roadmap ahead is substantial. We are now looking for a Junior Data \& AI Engineer to join our Frankfurt office and help take the platform to the next stage.



#### **The role**



You will join a two\-person data and AI team as the second hire, working directly with our in\-house data scientist who leads the data and AI workstream and has built the current version of Scale. Beyond the core team, you will work closely with a Manager, a Principal and two Partners from the investment team, who are actively involved in shaping priorities, reviewing work and using what we build day\-to\-day. The team is based in Frankfurt.



On day one you will be plugged into a real, production platform with established conventions, agentic workflows and two full\-stack web applications. Your job is to help extend it: new data sources, new agents, new features and everything in between. This is an unusually broad role for a junior hire. You will work across the full stack, ship production code used by investment professionals within your first weeks, and learn from and ship alongside the data scientist who has been building the platform.



The role is not purely technical. A meaningful part of the job is helping the rest of the firm get more out of data and AI, by rolling out tools, acting as a sparring partner for the investment team on technical due diligences and exchanging learnings with portfolio companies on AI and data topics.



#### **What you will do**


* Build and maintain data pipelines ingesting internal and external sources into our data warehouse and make the data accessible to the team and AI agents

 As a Senior AI Engineer in Pre\-training Data, you will work across the full stack of data preparation \- from sourcing and acquisition to processing, filtering, and mixture design. Some weeks you'll be deep in data quality analysis, understanding what makes a corpus valuable and how its composition affects downstream performance on public and bespoke evaluation tasks.  Your work sits at high leverage: the data you source, curate and synthesize directly determines what our models learn, how well they perform, and where they fall short. You'll have direct influence on the models we ship.

* Co\-Own data pipelines end\-to\-end: Design, build, and maintain the infrastructure that sources, processes, deduplicates, filters, and prepares pre\-training corpora at scale. Own the conversion from curated corpora to training\-ready streaming formats.

description:

* Du entwickelst domänenübergreifende Lösungen, die Daten aus ERP\-, CRM\-, Cloud\- und Partnersystemen zusammenführen und in konsistente, geschäftsrelevante Empfehlungen überführen.
* Zudem verantwortest du den gesamten Produktionslebenszyklus – von APIs und CI/CD bis hin zu Monitoring, Observability und Guardrails für Sicherheit, Datenschutz und Qualität – und nutzt moderne KI\-Tools zur Effizienzsteigerung im Entwicklungsprozess.


**Deine Skills? Mehr als interessant:**  

* Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise mit Fokus auf KI\- oder agentenbasierte Systeme.
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python sowie praktische Erfahrung mit agentenbasierten Orchestrierungs\-Frameworks und modernen KI\-Architekturen.
* Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb produktiver Systeme mit Technologien wie Docker, Kubernetes, REST\-APIs und CI/CD\-Pipelines.
* Fundiertes Know\-how in LLM\-nahen Konzepten wie Tool\-Nutzung, Function Calling, strukturierte Outputs, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) sowie Evaluierung und Observability.
* Erfahrung mit Multi\-Agenten\-Architekturen, parallelen Workflows sowie idealerweise mit Graphtechnologien (z. B. Neo4j), MCP oder dem Microsoft\-Ökosystem (Azure, Fabric, Dynamics, Copilot).
* Gutes Verständnis für Geschäftsanforderungen, strukturierte und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise sowie sichere Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse; persönlich überzeugst du durch analytisches Denken, Qualitätsbewusstsein und einen starken Fokus auf robuste, sichere Systeme.


**Du verdienst echten Mehrwert. Freu dich deshalb auf:**

* Flexibilität: Je nach Aufgabengebiet und in Abstimmung mit deiner Führungskraft besteht die Möglichkeit, deine Arbeitszeit und deinen Arbeitsort individuell anzupassen.
* Rund\-um\-Sorglos\-Paket: Deine Zukunft ist uns wichtig. Das zeigt unsere attraktive Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung sowie unsere betriebliche Altersversorgung mit einer Bezuschussung von bis zu 100 Prozent.
* 30 Tage Urlaub: 6 Wochen freie Zeit, die du zur Erholung, Entspannung, zum Reisen und Füße hochlegen nutzen kannst.

title: AI Engineer
description:
At Orbitant we are looking for AI Engineers (mid and senior, remote).
 


  


**What is Orbitant?** 



  


 Humanity is living through its greatest acceleration. This is not a trend; it is a civilizational inflection point. The companies that will define the next era are not the ones with the most code, but the ones with the best judgment about what to build, how to architect it, and why it matters.
 


  


 Orbitant exists to provide that thrust. We are looking for engineers who don't just write code. They make the decisions that determine what to build and why.
 


  


**Our pillars:** 



  

  
* Solid engineering, no shortcuts. We build with intent, good practices, and a long\-term vision, designing clean, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
  
* Innovation with common sense. We explore emerging technologies, analyze them, and incorporate what truly adds value, avoiding passing trends.
  
* Business\-oriented technology. We always understand the why before the how. Every technical decision aligns with strategic objectives to drive impact and deliver value to the business.
  


  


**At Orbitant we promote:** 



  

  
* Teamwork and ownership of your work
  
* Sharing knowledge and learning constantly.
  
* Flexibility and freedom to carry out your work day\-to\-day.
  
* Push toward a higher orbit, for clients, for the team, and for yourself
  
* Mentoring and being mentored. Constant growth.
  
* Automating and working in an AI\-first way, betting on tools that help us.
  
* Enjoying what we do and feeling proud of the result.
  


  


**What are we looking for?** 



  


 At Orbitant we are looking for AI Engineers (mid and senior) specialized in building production\-grade systems with LLMs, with experience across different types of projects and environments, but above all with a strong desire to keep growing.
 


  


 Beyond experience, what we value most is attitude and alignment with our values. We are looking for people who:
 


  

  
* Enjoy learning in their day\-to\-day and sharing that knowledge
  
* Feel comfortable communicating with their team and with clients.
  
* Collaborate actively, without fear of asking or proposing.
  
* Bring their own ideas and don't simply wait to be assigned tasks.
  
* Seek to go a little beyond what is expected, always generating real impact.
  
* Have curiosity, a continuous improvement mindset, and a desire to build things to be proud of.
  


  


 We are looking for people who not only code, but understand the why behind what we do, and want to deliver real value. We don't hire someone for a project, but people we want to work with long\-term.
 


  


**Responsibilities:** 



  


 Among the main responsibilities you will have, we can highlight:
 


  

  
* Design, build, and ship to production AI agents and LLM\-based systems for national and international clients — from scoping with the client to deployment and operation.
  
* Take projects from pilot to production: define the evaluations that matter, instrument traceability, and ensure that what ships meets the agreed business outcomes.
  
* Implement and maintain RAG systems over client documentation and knowledge: chunking strategy, retrieval, reranking, ingestion pipelines.
  
* Design multi\-step agent and workflow architectures (e.g. with LangGraph) — state management, tool use, error recovery, cost management.
  
* Build evals (offline and online) with tools like Langfuse: define metrics, datasets, benchmarks against real outcomes — not against "the demo works".
  
* Design and integrate MCP servers and connect agents with existing client systems (ERPs, CRMs, internal tools).
  
* Contribute to Orbitant's internal AI\-first platform: reusable skills, libraries, templates, and components that accelerate delivery of future projects.
  
* Question the "why" before the "how" — collaborate with business profiles to define the outcome before the architecture.
  
* Review and improve code (your own and your teammates'), work with legacy code when needed, and maintain high quality standards.
  
* Mentor more junior teammates and share learnings (technical sessions, documentation, code reviews).
  
* Propose new techniques, tools, and processes when they add real value (not for hype).
  
* Be accountable for what you put in production: cost, latency, observability, failures.
  


  


**Requirements:** 



  


 Must\-have:
 


  

  
* Experience building production systems with LLMs: agents, RAG, generation pipelines, automations.
  
* Solid Python as your main working language.
  
* Hands\-on knowledge of an agent/workflow orchestration framework (e.g. LangGraph, LangChain, etc.).
  
* Experience designing and implementing evaluations (evals) and traceability of LLM\-based systems (e.g. Langfuse or another observability tool).
  
* Real understanding of prompt engineering: structuring, techniques (few\-shot, CoT, structured output, tool use).
  
* Experience with Vector DBs (pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma...) and RAG patterns (chunking, retrieval, reranking).
  
* Ability to reason about trade\-offs between providers and models (cost, latency, context window, capabilities) without being locked into a specific API.
  
* Anthropic power user: hands\-on mastery of Claude Code, Claude SDK, and the Anthropic ecosystem.
  
* MCP (Model Context Protocol): designing or consuming MCP servers.
  
* Solid engineering practices: clean code, testing, CI/CD, version control, ability to work with legacy code.
  
* Level of English that allows communication with international team and clients.
  
* "Pilot\-to\-production" mindset: errors, retries, observability, cost, offline \+ online evals.
  


  


 Nice to have:
 


  

  
* TypeScript/Node for full\-stack integrations and AI\-native product backends.
  
* Experience with Cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and knowledge of Docker/Kubernetes.
  
* Experience with fine\-tuning or lightweight training (LoRA, custom embeddings, reranking).
  
* Experience mentoring and helping other people grow.
  
* Knowledge of AI security and privacy (PII, prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage).
  
* OSS contributions, papers, talks, or public AI side\-projects.
  


  


**What we offer:** 



  

  
* 100% remote work (Spain\-based)
  
* Top office in Madrid with free attendance
  
* Real flexibility
  
* Latest generation MacBook
  
* Claude license
  
* Training and mentoring
  
* Flexible benefits with the possibility of health insurance
  
* Salary between €40,000 and €60,000 gross per year
  
* Referral bonus
  
* The chance to build the kind of engineering that gives companies escape velocity, and to reach your own
  
* Be part of a spectacular team that can't wait for you to join
  


  


 If you think you're a good fit, don't hesitate to apply, and if you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to reach out :)

**AI Operations Engineer**
==========================


**Team:** Technical Operations \- AI Operations


**About the Role**
------------------



At Opendoor, AI isn't a side project \- it's how we work. Across the company, teams default to AI to solve problems, ship faster, and remove friction from everything we do. The AI Operations team sits at the intersection of data, AI engineering, and operational systems.



You will help define the future of how we work across our Operations by building AI powered workflows, automation, and experiences that drive leverage across Operations. This is high agency work in high ambiguity \- turning messy problems into clean solutions, prototyping fast, and shipping.  

  

You'll design systems and influence tooling decisions that affect how our operations scale – so we need people who think critically about what they build, why, the impact it will have on our operations and how to measure success.



We're looking for AI\-native builders to join our team, blending Operational expertise and systems thinking to drive leverage across our teams. If you default to AI in how you approach work, you’ll fit right in.


**Why Join Us**
---------------


* Opportunity to shape AI Operations from the ground up
* Work on cutting\-edge systems directly impacting our Customers and Operations
* Collaborate with talented engineers, data scientists, product teams, and operational teams

  


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Turn ambiguous business problems into clear system designs, experiments, and implementation plans
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve our operational reliability, efficiency, and cost
* Prototype and ship rapid experiments that test improvements to workflows
* Evaluate build\-vs\-integrate decisions for AI tools and automation, with a bias toward scalable, maintainable solutions over one\-off demos
* Build and maintain AI\-powered automation, internal tools to improve how we work
* Assess and pressure\-test system architectures — your own and others' — for scaling limitations, failure modes, and operational sustainability
* Maintain clean, trustworthy data through thoughtful schemas, audits, and dashboards that improve visibility and decision making
* Implement monitoring and alerting for model performance, latency, and drift detection
* Troubleshoot production issues and conduct root cause analysis
* Partner with data scientists and R\&D to operationalize models
* Develop runbooks, documentation, and best practices for AI Operations

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------


**AI Alchemy:** You have high agency and a tinkering mindset. You default to experimenting, running variations with new tools and methods \- LLMs, automation platforms, coding assistants until you can transmute data into high quality results. You're comfortable writing SQL, working with APIs, and stitching tools together to ship solutions fast.

  

**Systems Thinking:** You understand how data flows, business and systems objectives, how decisions get made, and how changes in one part of an operation ripple across others. You evaluate global vs. local trade\-offs and can explain why a solution that works today might break at scale \- *before* someone has to ask.

  

**System Design:** You take complex, messy problems and reduce them to simple, durable architecture. You know when to build custom vs. integrate existing tools, and you proactively identify scaling limitations before they become technical debt.

  


**Communication:** Articulate problems clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. You write clean documentation, build dashboards that tell a story, and can walk a stakeholder through your design rationale.

  


**Impact Driven:** You optimize for impact over novelty, choosing the right tools for the job rather than chasing trends with a long range horizon, observability to ensure performance, scalability and resiliency

* Familiarity with LLM deployment, context engineering and comfortable writing SQL
* Understanding of machine learning lifecycle concepts: training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring

* AI coding assistants: Claude Code, Cursor, or similar

* Workflow automation: Gumloop, Zapier, or similar platforms
* Experience with MCP integrations is a plus
* Experience with data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks) is a plus

As a Lead AI Engineer / Technical Lead Manager, you will head the technical direction and execution of our LLM and Agentic Systems strategy, with a specialized focus on bridging cloud intelligence and embedded execution. * **Architecting Agentic Systems:** Lead the design of complex, multi\-agent autonomous systems. You will oversee frameworks that allow LLMs to automate workflows reliably in both resource\-constrained embedded environments and high\-compute cloud environments.
* **System Integration \& Scalability:** Partner with Platform and Hardware teams to architect the "AI/ML Backbone." You will ensure infrastructure supports low\-latency on\-device inference, vector database scaling, and efficient data exchange across the hardware ecosystem.

* **Cognitive Automation Strategy:** Identify high\-impact opportunities for cognitive automation (e.g., local summarization, real\-time reasoning) and delegate execution to maximize accuracy within the power and memory envelopes of our hardware.
* **Cross\-Functional Diplomacy:** Act as the primary liaison between AI Engineering and Product, Legal, and Hardware stakeholders. You will translate complex ML constraints—such as SRAM limitations or NPU capabilities—into clear business trade\-offs.

 You will have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We are an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions. Our product teams are vibrant and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy and highly performant teams. **Why is this role important?**
 The Business Intelligence team’s data engineers are strategic partners and catalysts, providing data\-as\-a\-service to support product, content, and operational decision\-making across the organization. To support our expanding AI practice, we are seeking a Data \& AI Engineer to scale the robust data foundations required for GenAI and machine learning initiatives.
   

  

 In this role, you will be a key contributor to our AI roadmap, responsible for maintaining our Azure Databricks platform, architecting new ETL/ELT pipelines, and developing the data\-centric solutions that power GenAI applications. You will work within a high\-performing, cross\-functional team to ensure our data lake is optimized to serve as the backbone for the next generation of AI\-driven business solutions and automated organizational workflows.
   

  

 We are open to qualified candidates located within Canada with work authorization, but the CBC’s BI team is based in Toronto.
   

  

**Here’s why we should work together:**
 Our digital teams’ values \- collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement \- embody who we are as a people\-focused, digital\-forward employer. Our dedicated people managers work closely with every individual to ensure we are leveraging their strengths, championing their ideas and supporting their pursuit of new skills and their desired career progression.

* Hybrid work environment with flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work;
* Enrollment in a generous defined benefits pension plan;
* Competitive total rewards package;
* 20% of time for innovation, learning and development; wherever your interests lie;
* Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology;
* Opportunities for continued learning and professional development;
* Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups;
* Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent;
* A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected;
* A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity;
* An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.


**How you will make an impact:**
* The CBC’s digital footprint is one of the largest in Canada, which means you will have the opportunity to work with one of the largest datasets in Canada as well as one of the country’s most visible and highly respected companies.
* The BI team is a high\-performing team that has transformed how the CBC thinks about its data, audience, and products. Our big data engineering practice is rapidly expanding our AI capacity, and you will be a key player in shaping this process.
* You will ingest and transform diverse data sources specifically for AI initiatives, ensuring data readiness for LLMs and agentic workflows.
* You will be part of an established big data engineering practice, working alongside counterparts at Radio\-Canada to align data strategies. Your contributions are guaranteed to be felt by many, both in and out of the BI team.


**What you could bring to our team:**
 The expertise:
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in Big Data Engineering, specifically handling high\-volume clickstream or event data.
* Experience architecting robust data models optimized for downstream data analysis and AI/ML applications.
* Deep experience in enforcing data quality and governance.
* Experience building data pipelines that support LLM applications, such as RAG or vector\-based search.
* Experience integrating LLMs into workflows to automate business processes.


 The technical skills:
   

  

* Deep experience with the Azure ecosystem, specifically Azure Databricks, EventHub, ADLS Gen2, and Azure DevOps.
* Proficiency in Python (PySpark) and SQL for large\-scale, distributed data processing.
* Experience with workflow automation tools, specifically Apache Airflow.
* Solid understanding of distributed computing and big data best practices using Spark.
* Experience handling structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data in both batch and streaming contexts.

* You thrive in an autonomous and ambiguous environment that rejects “business as usual.”


 The right attitude:
   

  

* You enjoy working with people and sharing your knowledge with them in a collaborative way. You approach things with a beginner’s mind and are constantly curious and learning.

* You are skilled at presenting ideas to non\-technical stakeholders and management. You know how to listen and empathize with others. You are fluent in English and are an excellent verbal and written communicator.

 Qualified candidates will be subject to a practical assessment of the above requirements.

* Solid understanding of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, design patterns)

* Experience building and operating production systems, including debugging and troubleshooting
* Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MSSQL
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred: EC2, RDS, S3, API Gateway)
* Experience working in Agile environments and using tools like Jira


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Python and the PostgreSQL ecosystem
* Experience with event\-driven systems, queues, and ETL pipelines
* Familiarity with vector databases and MCP\-based architectures
* Interest in financial markets, investing, or fund research


**Base Salary Compensation Range**
 $106,037\.00 \- $ 126,094\.00
   

  

**Incentive Target Percentage**
 7\.5%
   

  

 If you receive and accept an offer from us, we require that personal and any related investments be disclosed confidentiality to our Compliance team (days vary by region). These investments will be reviewed to ensure they meet Code of Ethics requirements. If any conflicts of interest are identified, then you will be required to liquidate those holdings immediately. If this applies and your account(s) are not with an approved broker, you will be required to move your holdings to an approved broker.
   

  

 Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in\-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis.  Execution\-focused builder.

title: AI Solutions Analyst
company: Lake House Group | Shopify & Klaviyo Agency
description:
We're a small team building at the edge of where AI meets eCommerce. Our clients want AI inside their operations: dashboards that build themselves, agents that read their data and deliver insights, internal tools that replace hours of manual work. Today, all of that runs through one person. We're hiring an AI Solutions Analyst to change that. It's also one of the best places in Quebec to deepen your AI skills on the job: we encourage it, we give you the time to learn, and we cover the unlimited tokens to actually go deep.
   





  




 The Role
 
  





 The AI Solutions Analyst's mandate is simple: turn our clients' AI ambitions into shipped tools, by first making sure we're solving the right problem. You'll sit on client calls, listen to whatever they bring, ask the questions that uncover whether the stated problem is the real one, and turn it into a prioritized roadmap of things that should actually get built. You'll then build the working prototypes yourself with Claude Code, on real client data, until they solve the problem. From there, our AI engineer takes the prototype and productionizes it.
 



 You'll co\-own the client relationship with our founder from day one. He brings the eCommerce instinct and the strategic frame. You bring the diagnostic muscle, the AI obsession, and the discipline to ship. With AI\-literate clients, you're a real\-world thinking partner who narrows options instead of fanning them out. With clients who don't yet know what AI can do for them, you're the person who shows them by building it.
 



 The growth path is real: this role is the front door to AI Product Owner at LHG within the next 12 to 18 months for the right person.
 



  





**What a typical week looks like:** 




 Sitting on three to four client calls and asking the questions that surface the real problem behind the stated one. Mapping out the existing process and identifying where AI creates leverage. Recommending the right delivery modality for each project (a Claude Project, a Claude Code script, a custom internal tool, a dashboard delivered by email). Building a working prototype on real client data with Claude Code. Briefing the AI engineer on what needs to ship to production. Demoing the prototype to the client. Updating each client's AI roadmap and prioritizing the next two weeks. Pushing back on a request that doesn't make sense.
   

  




 Reality Check
 
  





 Lake House has tripled in size over 3 years and is aiming to do it again. The AI services side of the agency is one of our biggest growth bets, and today it still runs entirely through the founder. This role is what unlocks the next wave.
 



  





**This is a builder role.** 
 The AI Solutions Analyst will help shape how AI services get sold and delivered at LHG, not just execute existing playbooks.
   

  




 Non\-Negotiables
 
  





**Deep AI obsession and fluency.** 
 This is the most important non\-negotiable. AI isn't a job for you, it's a space you'd be paying attention to anyway. You already use Claude or ChatGPT every day to do deeper, sharper work, not just to go faster. You're already comfortable with Claude Code (or Cursor, or comparable) and have shipped at least a few personal projects with it. You're already building Claude skills, custom GPTs, or lightweight agents that compound your output, or you're hungry to. You read AI Twitter, you've tried the latest models the day they came out, you've broken things and fixed them. You don't wait for a course to learn the next thing.
 



  





**Diagnostic instinct.** 
 You don't take the brief at face value. When a client says "we want X", you ask the questions that uncover whether X is the right problem to solve, or just the symptom of a deeper one. You can sit in a meeting, listen, and spot what the client hasn't named yet. You translate what you hear into a clear process flow with the real leverage points marked, and you can tell the difference between a step that should be automated and a step where the human judgment IS the value. This is the muscle ex\-consulting analysts build over years on the job: asking sharp, structured questions until the real shape of the problem emerges.
 



  





**1 to 3 years scoping problems and building things for clients or stakeholders.** 
 Could be consulting, product, strategy, startup operations, or a strong internship track. You've sat across from a stakeholder, listened to them describe a mess, and translated it into something that got built. You know what a good discovery conversation feels like. Or you're a recent graduate with serious internships and personal AI builds you can show us.
 



  





**Client presence.** 
 You're comfortable on a Zoom with a client VP. You ask the right questions, you don't get frozen, you can challenge politely, and you can hold your own when the room is mostly senior. You don't need a script.
 



  





**Bilingual French/English.** 
 You'll lead client meetings, scope projects, and demo prototypes in both languages every day. This is mandatory, not optional. Most of our clients are French\-speaking Quebec brands.
 



  





**Hands\-on mentality.** 
 You build the prototype yourself. You sit on the call yourself. You write the brief for the AI engineer yourself. You're not above the work, and you're not waiting for someone to do it for you.
   

  




 Nice to Have
 
  




* Background in management consulting, strategy, product, or startup operations
* Personal portfolio of AI builds: agents, Claude skills, custom GPTs, side projects you can demo
* Experience writing technical specs or product requirements documents
* Previous experience juggling multiple client relationships in parallel


 What Makes Someone Succeed Here
 
  





 You bring ideas, you don't wait to be told what to scope. You're skeptical of the brief: when a client says "we want X", you ask three questions before you accept that X is what should get built. You narrow options instead of fanning them out, because if the client already has Claude, what they don't have is someone in the real world who can say "don't do that, do this." You're rigorous about the difference between "AI could technically do this" and "AI should do this." You catch what others miss in a process map. You can shift between strategic (where should this client's AI roadmap go in 12 months) and tactical (writing a Claude Code prompt right now). You see AI as the unlock that makes you ten times more useful, not as a tool to be afraid of. You're allergic to slow, abstract work that produces a deck instead of a thing.
 



  





  




 What we offer
 
  




* Hybrid work. A mix of working from home and from our downtown Montreal WeWork office.
* Competitive salary.
* Wellness and cell phone allocation.
* Real time and unlimited tokens to deepen your AI skills. We invest in your AI fluency the way other agencies invest in conferences.
* Room to grow. Small team means real impact.
* Learning environment. We're obsessed with getting better.
* Autonomy.



  





  




 About Lake House Group
 
  





 Lake House Group is an AI Commerce agency for Shopify brands. We help companies grow by building strong retention engines (email, SMS, CRM), sharpening their go\-to\-market, and embedding AI across marketing, operations, and product management.
 



 Through the right mix of technology, training, and hands\-on partnership, Lake House helps brands move with more clarity, speed, and adaptability in the era of intelligent commerce.

 For more information visit cultureamp.com.
   

  

**How you can help make a better world of work**
 We're looking for an Engineer to join the AI Research \& Experience team, helping build critical components for AI Coach \- Culture Amp's contextually\-aware AI system that integrates survey insights, performance management, and interpersonal dynamics to deliver personalized support to organizations, teams, and individuals at scale.
   

  

 You'll work at the intersection of applied AI research and product engineering, translating cutting\-edge techniques into production systems that genuinely improve how people experience work. This isn't a research lab \- you'll be shipping features that solve real customer problems.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Staying up to date with current research, literature and provider offerings.
* Design, implement and evaluate areas and features of our multi\-agentic platform and systems using modern frameworks (e.g., LangGraph) for stateful, multi\-turn coaching conversations.
* Advise, help build, and orchestrate data pipelines that unify fragmented workplace data (surveys, goals, performance reviews, feedback, 1\-1 notes) into coherent coaching context
* Translate customer requirements into technical solutions \- working backwards from user needs to system design. Creating technical documentation to support literacy, technical transfer and engineering practice.
* Partner closely with product, design, and people science to ensure the features developed are fit for purpose, and in\-line with the existing product expectations to ensure seamless partnership transfer of technology.
* Contribute to evaluation frameworks and bias testing to meet enterprise requirements for transparency and fairness
* Build cutting\-edge, working prototypes, integrated into our environments which validate new approaches and accelerate learning.


**What We're Looking For**
**Must Haves:**
* Proven commercial experience taking ML/AI systems to production.
* Strong technical writer and communicator
* Full stack software development experience, ideally Python, React, PGVector
* Strong software engineering fundamentals \- you write clean, tested, maintainable code.
* You leverage Software development AI tooling effectively.
* Experience with LLM application development (prompt and context engineering, RAG, agent architectures)
* You fit our values with the proactivity to take risks, and the humility to learn in public. You take pride in your work and its successful utilisation, stability, extendability and maintainability.


**Desirable:**
* Hands\-on experience designing and integrating data pipelines \- you're comfortable moving data across systems, working within rigorous security standards, handling messy real\-world inputs, and building robust orchestration
* A pragmatic, solution\-focused mindset \- you evaluate new technology through the lens of "does this scalably solve the problem?" not "is this technically interesting?"


**Strong signals:**
* Experience at startups or founding teams \- comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration
* Postgraduate degree (Masters or PhD) in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative field
* Evidence of taking cutting\-edge (relevant) techniques from paper to production
* Experience with evaluation/benchmarking frameworks for AI systems
* Experience integrating scalable solutions such as advanced Speech\-to\-Text (STT) and Text\-to\-Speech (TTS) pipelines (e.g., Whisper, ElevenLabs) with streaming capabilities
* Experience implementing GraphRAG or Knowledge Graphs (e.g., Neo4j)

* Open source contributions or public technical writing

 Additionally, we don't just focus on our internal community; we believe in creating a better world of work for all. We're committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, with Employee Resource Groups and ally communities in place.

**About Liberty** 




 Helping people is at the core of who we are. As Australia’s top non\-bank lender, we’ve spent decades providing free\-thinking and innovative loans and have assisted over 500,000 individuals in achieving financial stability. Our range of flexible, tailored products and our dedication to creating outstanding customer experiences are at the heart of what we do.
 



 We are a collaborative and vibrant community, driven by our core values. Our vision of leading the finance sector with innovative thinking is guided by FLAIR, our five key principles of being Fair, Learning, Accountable, Invested, and Resourceful. These values shape our perspective, interactions with customers, and relationships with one another.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We’re looking for an AI Engineer to design, build and deploy AI‑centred solutions that create real commercial value and operational efficiency across Liberty.
 



 This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, data and engineering, delivering intelligent systems that are scalable, robust and production‑ready. You’ll play a key role in advancing Liberty’s AI capabilities, from prompt engineering and model optimisation through to embedding AI seamlessly into products and services.
 



 You’ll be part of our Technology team, working closely with delivery, product and business stakeholders in an agile environment that values experimentation, learning and ownership. This role requires a minimum of three days per week in the office to support collaboration and knowledge sharing.
 



  





**What you will be doing** 



* Designing, developing and deploying AI\-driven systems and solutions that improve efficiency, insight and customer experience.
* Researching, evaluating and implementing state\-of\-the\-art AI models, tools and techniques to solve complex business problems.
* Ensuring AI solutions are robust, scalable and production\-ready through monitoring, optimisation and ongoing maintenance.
* Analysing large and complex datasets to support AI model training, validation and insight generation.
* Rigorously testing and refining prompts and AI outputs to ensure quality, relevance and contextual accuracy.
* Working across teams to integrate AI capabilities into products and services in line with business objectives.
* Documenting AI models, prompt engineering approaches, best practices and outcomes to share learning and lift capability.
* Actively participating in agile ceremonies, experimentation and OKR\-driven delivery.
* Building AI solutions that are compliant, ethical and aligned with Liberty’s risk and governance frameworks.



  





**Enough about us, lets talk about you** 



* You’re passionate about applying AI in practical, responsible ways to deliver business outcomes.
* You enjoy solving complex problems using data, experimentation and evidence\-based decision making.
* You’re comfortable working with AI models, prompt engineering, data analysis and automation in real\-world environments.
* You understand the importance of risk, governance, PII and compliance when working with AI and data.
* You thrive in an agile, collaborative environment and enjoy working cross\-functionally.
* You’re curious, proactive, and committed to continuous learning as AI technologies evolve.
* Experience working with large datasets, AI/ML platforms, or cloud\-based AI services will be highly regarded.

 Being named Employer of the Year at the Women in Finance Awards in 2021 and 2023 and Employer of Choice Winner for 2023 at the Australian Business Awards, reflects our ongoing commitment to making Liberty the best place to work. We believe that beyond competitive financial rewards, it's the thoughtful, small touches that truly make a difference in supporting our team's needs and well\-being. \- we provide access to a large number of great benefits such as:

* We are social with monthly themed lunches and events, EOY and EOFY parties, and corporate casual dress

description:
Help shape what’s next in practical AI delivery
   

  

 At Altis, we’re looking for someone who can combine strong technical foundations, conceptual agility, and a modern consulting mindset to help solve real business problems with AI.
   

  

 This is not a role for someone who wants to stay in one narrow lane. We’re looking for a highly adaptable technology generalist with a strong software engineering background, sharp problem\-solving capability, and a genuine interest in applying AI in practical, commercially valuable ways.
   

  

 You do not need to be a deep machine learning specialist or career data scientist. What matters more is your ability to move between business challenges and technical solutioning, work across different contexts, and turn ideas into outcomes that make sense in the real world.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

 In this role, you’ll work across client and internal initiatives to design and deliver practical, end\-to\-end solutions that use AI and related technologies to improve processes, decision\-making, and business outcomes.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Work closely with stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into practical technical solutions
* Design and deliver end\-to\-end solutions in commercial, enterprise, or consulting environments
* Apply AI and ML tools pragmatically to improve workflows, processes, and outcomes
* Use AI development tools such as Claude to accelerate software delivery and improve productivity
* Design and build practical applications that bring together business needs, software engineering, and AI capability
* Contribute to the development of Azure web applications using .NET and C\#
* Move confidently between business context, solution design, and technical delivery
* Bring a flexible, concept\-driven approach to solving problems across different domains and client environments
* Contribute to solutions that embed AI into real business settings, rather than focusing on research\-led model development
* Learn and apply new technologies quickly, adapting to different challenges and delivery contexts
* Work with guidance from senior leaders while taking ownership of your contribution and delivery outcomes


 What we’re looking for
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who combines strong fundamentals with the adaptability to work across both technical and business contexts.
   

  

**What You Ideally Bring**
* A background in software development, software engineering, or solution delivery
* Proven experience in software engineering
* Proven experience designing and delivering solutions end to end
* Experience building Azure web applications using .NET and C\#
* The ability to leverage AI tools such as Claude to accelerate software development
* Exposure to AI/ML\-enabled solutions, even if AI has not been your sole focus to date
* Experience working in commercial, enterprise, or consulting environments
* Strong conceptual thinking and the ability to apply transferable problem\-solving approaches across different domains
* The ability to work through ambiguity and shape practical outcomes from loosely defined challenges
* Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* The maturity to work with direction and coaching, while still operating with initiative and flexibility


 The mindset that matters
   

  

 Technical capability is important, but it is only part of the picture.
   

  

**We’re Also Looking For Someone Who Brings**
* Conceptual agility and the ability to recognise patterns across different business problems
* Adaptability, with the confidence to move between technical detail, client needs, and broader business priorities
* A strong foundational software engineering mindset
* A commercial orientation and focus on real\-world outcomes
* Curiosity about how AI can be embedded into workflows and solutions
* A strong learning mindset, with openness to coaching and growth
* A practical, solutions\-focused approach rather than a purely theoretical one


 Why this role matters
   

  

 This role is about helping bridge the gap between business opportunity and technical delivery.
   

  

 You’ll play an important part in shaping how AI is applied in practical settings, helping clients and teams move beyond ideas into solutions that are useful, scalable, and outcome\-focused. It’s a strong opportunity for someone who wants to work broadly, keep learning, and build capability in one of the fastest\-evolving areas of technology.
   

  

 Why join Altis?
   

  

 At Altis, you’ll work with a team that values curiosity, innovation, and practical impact.
   

  

 You’ll have the opportunity to solve real client challenges, contribute to the growth of our AI capability, and work across a mix of delivery, advisory, and capability\-building activities. We’re a collaborative team that supports each other, encourages fresh thinking, and values people who can combine technical excellence with commercial and client awareness.
   

  

 Your next chapter starts here
   

  

 If you’re excited by the opportunity to design and deliver responsible, high\-value AI solutions in a consulting environment, we’d love to hear from you.

**Job Description:**

The **Director, Solution Architecture** for Agentic AI and Corporate Systems reports to the Assistant Vice President for Corporate Enterprise Architecture and leads solution architecture for complex, high impact initiatives across business groups.


This role ensures that solution designs are aligned with enterprise architecture standards, business strategy, and technology roadmaps while enabling efficient, high quality delivery. The initial focus of this role will be solution architecture leadership for Agentic AI and Generative AI\-enabled initiatives, with support for additional Corporate IT initiatives as priorities evolve.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Master ’s degree is an asset.
* Architecture certifications such as TOGAF, IASA, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent are preferred.
* Relevant cloud and AI credentials are valued, such as AWS Certified AI Practitioner, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer \- Associate, Azure AI Engineer, or equivalent credentials.
